name: Natural Language to FHIR Query Agent
description: Convert a natural language question into a transparent, read-only FHIR search or SQL query, validate it as safe, execute it, and show the generated query alongside a result preview.

inputs.label: Question
inputs.default: Show diabetic patients with HbA1c above 9 in the last 6 months

agent.instruction: Convert the user's natural language question into a safe, read-only FHIR search or SQL-style query. Show interpreted intent, the generated query, a validation status, the result preview, and any limitations. Never generate a write operation.

context.question: Show diabetic patients with HbA1c above 9 in the last 6 months
